archetypes.hierarchy_rules: The table structure is a reconciliation. 'Net income' is the numerator. 'Weighted average shares outstanding' (Basic and Diluted) are the denominators. 'Earnings per share' (Basic and Diluted) are the results. Indentation may be used to group basic and diluted calculations.
archetypes.source_number_format_rules: Per-share amounts are presented with a dollar sign and two decimal places. Share counts are absolute numbers. Monetary values (e.g., Net Income) are in thousands. Negative numbers are in parentheses.
